baseline.note: User-supplied Ver1.05 canonical source used as the sole starting baseline for this development chat.

final_release_adjustments: Contest submission final-stage Input confirmation and File save actions moved into the fixed wizard footer.

OPPLACE unconditional required_fields reviewed across contest rules: common portable-operation requirement retained; all-station unconditional requirement retained only for All Chiba, All Hyogo, KCJ, and KCJ Top Band.
VERSION, release packaging references, tests, and canonical handoff documentation updated to 1.06.
source_of_final_canonicalization.rule: Future work must start from this Ver1.06 canonical ZIP only. Do not reconstruct by replaying Ver1.05 canonical plus 1.051–1.059 PATCH/FIX archives.

final_features_highlights: [A] amateur standard-tab naming, persistent recently-closed tabs, RMKS2 using <<RMKS2>> inside the unchanged 11-field TXT format.
LogSearch immediate post-record editing, exact-QSO deletion, checked-row handoff actions, current-log full-display shortcut, and embedded callsign column/status improvements.
Three-step normal export with configurable RMKS1/RMKS2 mappings while fixed format fields remain standard.
Contest/QSO Party/Award rule and condition viewers, generic contest-category filtering that never drops registered categories, and contest band-count color badges.
Contest submission final actions stay visible in the fixed footer; OPPLACE is not globally forced for fixed operation unless the contest explicitly requires it.
Free-radio support is intentionally deferred to Ver1.061+ and is not implemented in this baseline.
